pages.text: In vacuum, impacts can $(danger)puncture$() a sealed EVA suit.

pages.title: Venting
pages.text: Each breach vents carried O2; two drain twice as fast.$(br2)Cold, hunger and suffocation can't puncture the suit.$(br2)Breaches stop venting in breathable shelter, but stay until patched.

pages.title: Patching
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Tattered Clothing Scrap$(): hold it for a slow seal that may fail later$(li)$(item)ORSA Suit Patch Kit$(): one breach, quick and permanent$(br2)Damage interrupts either.

pages.title: ORSA Suit Patch Kit
pages.text: A permanent pressure seal. Intact Major Hearths may also contain salvaged kits, assuming the collective permits recovery.
